request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund 12 months of part-time maintenance and enhancement work for Oura, a TxPipe open-source Cardano event pipeline tool.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The on-chain withdrawal amount is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
Oura is a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.
Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and supports sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposal says Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and identifies its GitHub repository as https://github.com/txpipe/oura.
The proposal says Oura has been funded twice through Project Catalyst in Funds 9 and 13 for feature development.
The proposal says TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting results and audit materials.
The proposal states that the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

Intersect plans to administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified reserve and project-specific addresses, multisignature-style role approvals, an external Oversight Committee, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance by TxPipe, routed through Intersect treasury smart-contract administration, with stated maintenance, support, documentation, oversight, and budget-process claims.
